datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework across Burkina Faso administrative units. IPC classifications were spatially mapped and compiled into geographic datasets for medium-term projections at four time points in 2012 (January, April, July, October).
